title: Pins on the Number Line
statement:
You have `n` closed segments `[l_i, r_i]` on a number line. Place pins at integer positions so that every segment contains at least one pin. A pin sitting exactly on an end of a segment counts as being inside it. Find the smallest number of pins.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. Each of the next `n` lines contains `l_i` and `r_i`.

## Output
Print the smallest number of pins.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 8000`
- `0 <= l_i <= r_i <= 10^9`
